props.html:
Home › Build Your Display

Build Your Light-Up Display

Type a word, a name, a number or a date and watch it light up in one row, made from photographs of our own 1.2m pieces, with its width in metres and the price for your delivery zone.

Type your word, name or number

Use the letters A to Z, the numbers 0 to 9 and five symbols: a heart, an ampersand, a hashtag, an @ sign and a ring. Every display stands in one row, and a space leaves a gap between words.

Examples: LOVE with a heart, MR & MRS, HAPPY 21, a six-letter name, or a year such as 2027.

Or start with

See it in a venue

Example: HAPPY 21, seven pieces in one row.

Tap a piece to add it. The two small lights show how many of each we have left.

We hold two of every letter, number and symbol, all 1.2 m tall.

Delivery zone and hire length

Delivery, set-up and collection is one fee per hire, by zone:

Western SydneyParramatta, Blacktown, Fairfield, Auburn, Lidcombe$90
South West SydneyLiverpool, Campbelltown, Bankstown, Camden$110
Hills DistrictCastle Hill, Baulkham Hills, Rouse Hill, Kellyville$120
Inner West & CBDNewtown, Leichhardt, Strathfield, Sydney CBD$130
Sutherland Shire & St GeorgeCronulla, Miranda, Hurstville, Kogarah$140
PenrithPenrith and nearby suburbs$140
Eastern SuburbsBondi, Randwick, Double Bay, Maroubra$150
North Shore & Northern BeachesChatswood, Hornsby, Manly, Dee Why$160

The price is for the event day. A weekend hire, Friday to Monday, is 1.5 times the event-day price, and a full week is 2.2 times.

Hire length

Your live price

Worked example: HAPPY 21 for an event day, delivered to Western Sydney.

  • 7 pieces × $99$693
  • Multi-piece discount 15%−$104
  • Delivery, set-up and collection: Western Sydney$90
Total$679

A 30% deposit of $204 holds the date. The balance and a $200 refundable bond are due seven days before the event.

    Send it as a quote

    When the display looks right, send it to us with your date and suburb. We confirm availability and the final price the same business day.

    Send this display → 
    

    An estimate, not a booking. Prices include GST. The minimum hire is two pieces.
    

    

    

    How the builder works
    

    The builder prices a display the way we do. Each piece is $99 for the event day, with a minimum of two pieces. Four to six pieces take 10% off the whole display, seven to nine take 15% off and ten or more take 20% off. Then one delivery fee is added for your zone, which covers set-up and collection. If you would like the detail first, see how prices are worked out.
    

    The preview uses photographs of our own pieces, with a person shown for scale and the width of the row in metres, so you can judge how much room it needs. The width is a guide, and we confirm it with your quote. We hold two of every letter, number and symbol; if your word needs three of one letter, the builder tells you and we confirm what can be arranged. To check the pieces before you type, browse the A–Z or browse numbers 0–9.
    

    Nothing is booked until we have confirmed your date. When you are happy with the display, send as a quote and we reply the same business day.
